title: Construct Validity for Cross-Context Consistency Scores: Nine Pre-Registered Confound Tests Across 36,000 Drug and Genetic Perturbations
description: Nine pre-registered tests of whether direction instability, a cross-context consistency score for drug and genetic perturbations, is confounded by toxicity programs, off-target consistency, or universal-essential effects. Corrections preserve population rankings while reorganizing individual perturbations.
